source_title: Binance Adds FRONT/BTC, EASY/BTC, CAKE/BTC, CAKE/USDT & BAKE/BUSD Trading Pairs

spot_trading_start.statement: Binance announced that CAKE/USDT spot trading was scheduled to open at 06:00 UTC on 2021-02-19.

limitations: This record authenticates the project's source check, not an immutable copy of the third-party webpage.
This is the CAKE/USDT pair start, not CAKE's earlier first listing against other quote assets.
The displayed publication clock has no stated timezone, so only its calendar date is stored.
